_doc: The names of a project symbol (test of the rc.29, 23-11-2026): what the editor of the symbols accepts
(`idProblem` in sws-editor/src/symbols/editor/model.ts) and what the compiler accepts (`nome_ammesso` and
the part rules in sws-runtime/crates/sws-core/src/simboli_prj.rs). Read by sws-editor/tests/symbolEditorModel.test.ts
and by the cargo test `symbol_ids_follow_the_shared_fixture`: the two rules can't drift apart.
`input` = parts and inputs (`parte`, `ingresso`), `port` = pipe ports (`bocca`). `rejected` maps a name to the
editor's reason; `editorOnly` are names the compiler accepts and the editor refuses (`state` is the body's
input in the editor). Uniqueness is not here: it depends on the symbol.
